content.text: Vacation rentals in El SalvadorAmazing rental locations in El SalvadorPlan your next trip to the beautiful country of El Salvador. You will be able to find this destination located in Central America, bordering Honduras, Guatemala and the Pacific Ocean. The largest city and the capital of this country are San Salvador, the perfect spot if you are looking to experience the metropolitan life of El Salvador. The country's name means The Savior in Spanish and it has a population of 6.8 million inhabitants. With a rich and extensive history, El Salvador used to be populated by the Lenca, the Mayans and the Cuzcatlecs. You will be able to explore archaeological monuments that can be dated back as early as the Olmec times which is around the first millennium BC.Vacation Rentals in El SalvadorThere are plenty of rental properties for you to enjoy while staying in El Salvador. Whether you want to be located in the big city to experience the bustling nightlife, closer to the beach for a relaxing vacation or immersed in nature to explore the natural landscape of the country, you will be able to choose from numerous options. Imagine waking up in the morning with the waves crashing against the beach right outside your window. Spend your afternoon laying by your private pool and enjoying the sun. Spend your evening drinking some wine on your balcony while admiring the city lights. These are some of the memories you could be making in El Salvador.Vacations in El SalvadorThe area and getting aroundYou will find that there are many ways to make your trip to El Salvador. The main highways in El Salvador are the Pan-American highway (CA-1) which is also called the Carretera Panamericana, the Litoral Highway (CA-2), and the North Longitudinal Highway. On the other hand, you can even travel with the public buses that connect to all the main cities in the country. If you wish to fly to your destination, the main airport will be the El Salvador International Airport. This airport is the third busiest airport in Central America and the main airport serving the Republic of El Salvador. Where to eat in El SalvadorYou will be able to find plenty of delicious eateries to enjoy while staying in El Salvador. If you want to have an upscale dining experience, head to Restaurante Citron. This stylish restaurant in Zona Rosa has a seasonally changing menu filled with classic Salvadoran ingredients and distinctive flavors. On the other hand, if you want to have something more casual, head to Los Tacos de Paco. Here you will find the best and most authentic Mexican food in San Salvador in an establishment that also has a bookshop and art gallery.Travelers and activitiesSan Salvador for outdoor explorersWith the vast natural landscape that surrounds the country, you will be able to find outdoor adventures wherever you go in El Salvador. Hike the Ilamatepec while visiting El Salvador. This volcano hike is located in the corridor named Apaneca-llamatepec and it takes a total of four hours to climb and ascend. Another great hike can be found in the Cerro Verde National Park. The trails in this park will take you through the nature of El Salvador while also stumbling upon various historical landmarks.El Salvador for family activitiesIf you decide to make your trip to El Salvador with your family, try out these activities for a wonderful time together. An educational experience that can be enjoyed by train lovers is visiting the Railway Museum. At the railway museum, you will have the chance to see train cars as well as sit in a couple of them and take a ride. Another delightful activity in El Salvador is visiting the Coffee Farms. Take a tour and learn about the rich history the country has with producing coffee and exporting it to all corners of the world.Did you know that El Salvador’s nickname is the Land of Volcanos?Top 5 travel tips for El Salvador1. Tazumal And Joya De Cerén Learn about the ancient civilization that used to live in the area. These two places will allow you to admire the ancient ruins of Mayan cities.2.Santa Ana Cathedral Visit a splendid cathedral. While in Santa Ana, you will have the possibility to stroll through a lovely square and admire the stunning architecture. 3. El Tunco Go for a day out surfing. El Salvador is known for some of the best surfing spots in the world. This area has wives who can be enjoyed by beginners and experts. 4.Tamanique Waterfalls Do go chasing waterfalls in El Salvador. The Tamanique waterfalls are just a short drive away from El Tunco and then you will be able to find a 30-minute hike to this waterfall. 5.Ruta de Flores Take a hike and visit local towns. This route will take you through iconic towns, which are Salcoatitán, Nahuizalco, Apaneca, Ataco and Juayua.How much do you pay, on average, for vacation rentals in El Salvador?Last year, rentals in El Salvador had an annual average price of around $171 per night.During which months can you find the best price for vacation rentals in El Salvador?If you would like to save as much as possible during your visit to El Salvador, travel in September ($118 per night on average), October ($134), or November ($153), to find the lowest prices for the whole year.During which months are vacation rentals more expensive in El Salvador?When it comes to booking a vacation rental in El Salvador, the highest prices are found in the month of January (with an average of $213 per night), followed by June ($202), and then April ($196).Is it necessary to plan a trip to El Salvador well in advance?It is recommended that you book your stay with plenty of time when visiting El Salvador, as only 47% of our properties are usually available throughout the year.What time of the year can I find more available vacation rentals?The best months to find free accommodation in El Salvador are September (the average amount of properties that are free reached 60% of the total last year), October (56%), and August (54%).When are there fewer vacation rental options available in El Salvador?According to data from last year, the months when it is most difficult to find accommodation in El Salvador are, in order, January (with 36% of available rentals), December (37%), and November (41%).How many rentals does Holidu have in El Salvador?Holidu has 580 vacation rentals in El Salvador, provided by 2 different partners.
